new_senses.rationale: The Turoyo question pairs saymiwo with maṣnəʕiwo, gives blacksmiths as subject and then names implements. This supports one manufacturing meaning. One attestation; III is provisional from ma-CCəC, and [maṣnəʕ] is a segmented base rather than an independently attested third-singular form.
